description: Deep-dive on a single offer: net revenue (gross minus refunds), paid orders + AOV, checkout completion rate (started-to-paid; page views are not tracked), bump/upsell take rates + upsell revenue, refund rate, daily revenue series, and the 20 most recent orders. Use for how-is-X-doing questions and before recommending changes to an offer.
name: get_offer_stats
title: Get stats for one offer
